description: Single source for Remotion segment backdrops + agent-facing selectionBrief. Tools: generate_manifest.py validates [BACKDROP: id]; agents pick id by reading selectionBrief. chartFit (optional): high | medium | low = max recommended foreground chart/detail density for pairing with Remotion templates; omit → derive from density (quiet→high, medium→medium, busy→low). See design-references/backdrops/BACKDROP_CHART_PAIRING.md.

backdrops.notes: Low-density topographic wash. Neutral. Pairs with any analytical content.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Neutral geographic/topographic flat wash — no strong metaphor. Use as safe default for maps, routes, or any chart when no other backdrop fits better.

backdrops.notes: Quiet sky over a low horizon line. Atmospheric supportive register.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Open sky over a low horizon — calm, vast, minimal anchor. Good for existential summaries, scale, or closing beats without urban detail.

backdrops.notes: City silhouette along the bottom edge. Contemporary, urban register.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Contemporary city read as a thin silhouette along the bottom — tech/modern competition, urban systems, without busy skyline hero shots.

backdrops.notes: Distant portico sits between hero and chart. Civic/institutional register.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Civic / institutional plaza energy — policy, governance, multilateral forums, public authority (quiet monumental space).

backdrops.notes: Single smokestack anchors left. Industrial/material register. Body text may need to lift.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Distant industrial yard — supply chains, manufacturing capacity, plants, reshoring, materials. Anchor left; pair hero layout accordingly.

backdrops.notes: Book wall + diagonal light beams on right. Archival/scholarly register.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Scholarly reading-room mood — frameworks, philosophy, dense terminology, thesis moments. Book mass anchors right; use hero-flipped pairing.

backdrops.notes: Suggested fab/cleanroom quiet field; single small vertical motif. Process, yield, nodes.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Semiconductor fab / cleanroom suggestion — lithography, yield curves, node gaps, process steps. Quiet interior field with one small vertical cue.

backdrops.notes: Abstract diagram/grid anchor lower-right; game theory, equilibrium charts.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Abstract grid / diagram fragment — game theory, Nash equilibrium, prisoners dilemma vs stag hunt, strategic metaphors without literal boards.

backdrops.notes: Band-stack sea/sky horizon; trade routes, chokepoints without literal ships.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Maritime distance — shipping lanes, chokepoints, trade geography, cables (abstract). Horizon low; no literal vessels.

backdrops.notes: Blank wall map/briefing plane left; strategic geography, escalation.
backdrops.selectionBrief: War-room / briefing-board suggestion — escalation ladders, alliance maps, operational geography where the chart carries detail.

backdrops.notes: Corridor/vault depth; records, policy history, sanctions timelines.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Archive / vault corridor — sanctions timelines, policy history, evidence chains, institutional memory (quieter than reading-room book wall).

backdrops.notes: Arid plain bands; distance, logistics, energy routes across emptiness.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Arid vastness — desert logistics, energy routes, strategic distance, Middle East / Central Asia scale without cartographic detail.

backdrops.notes: Low bridge/causeway silhouette; chokepoints, connectivity.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Bridge / chokepoint silhouette — connectivity vs bottleneck (Bosphorus-class metaphors), corridors, linked systems.

backdrops.notes: Dark CIC / ops floor — faint standby accents. Moody escalation register.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Dark operations-center mood — night-shift crisis framing, C2/briefing tension, escalation beats. Prefer when the segment wants noir-institutional gravity (not daytime plaza). Pairs with dense charts; anchor left.

backdrops.notes: Deep-water darkness with faint horizon band; cables/pipelines read abstract.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Abyssal / depth-field — submarine cables, maritime chokepoints beneath the surface, strategic depth under ice. Horizon low; cooler blacks than ink-only fills.

backdrops.notes: Industrial night yard — distant furnace or bloom; restrained amber rim.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Night-shift industrial — capacity runs hot/cold, energy-intensive processes, foundries, resilience of heavy industry. Warmer shadow family than abyss; anchor left for smokestack/bloom reads.

backdrops.notes: Urban night canopy — sparse sodium/LED spill, wet asphalt suggestion.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Noir metropolis canopy — tech competition, sanctions evasion night economies, urban resilience without a literal skyline hero. Thin silhouette along bottom; leave upper two-thirds quiet for charts.

backdrops.notes: Reading-room after hours — single shaft/runnel of warm light on book mass.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Archival night — classified annex energy, philosophy/thesis introspection, long-memory institutions. Dark register sibling to reading-room; book/shelving weight on right; use hero-flipped pairing.

backdrops.notes: Sparse star field with ghosted graticule; orbital / PNT / comms abstract.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Constellation + faint grid — GPS/GNSS fragility, Starlink-class constellations, COMSAT competition, night-sky strategy metaphors. Keep constellations minimal; no labeled constellations or UI chrome.

backdrops.notes: Rail or HV switching silhouettes; pooled amber cool-white spill.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Intermodal / grid switching yard at night — logistics chokepoints, sanctions diversion routes, power pooling. Bottom-weighted silhouettes; quieter than foundry-ember.

backdrops.notes: Broken plateau / chasm line against sky gradient — fracture metaphor.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Tectonic rift read — alliance fractures, decoupling fault lines, brittle-order metaphors. Desert/cliff sibling to desert-horizon but night ink field with a single hard horizon break.

backdrops.notes: Dark analytical field — faint ruled/grid plane only (no stars); equilibrium/diagram energy.
backdrops.selectionBrief: Dark-register abstract grid plane — game theory / equilibrium charts when you want a diagram substrate without strategy-grid's daylight paper. Faint meridian lines or ruled field at low contrast; centered quiet zone for overlays; **dark sibling to strategy-grid**.
